cluster.description: The Plural cluster handle identifying the cluster that contains the target pod

namespace.description: The Kubernetes namespace containing the target pod

pod.description: The exact name of the pod in which to execute the command

container.description: The exact name of the container in the target pod in which to execute the command

command.description: The complete command to execute in the target container. Prefer read-only diagnostic commands and limit output when possible.

explanation.description: Clearly explain why this command is needed, the target pod and container, the command's expected effect, and any potential impact so the user can make an informed approval decision
